newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB says trials new banking terminal.
newsitem.headline: NAB says trials new banking terminal.

text.p: Australia's largest bank, National Australia Bank, said on Monday it has started public trials of a touch-screen customer service terminal, designed to boost access to information and services.

Customers could use the terminals to learn about the bank's services, and get information from a "screen banker" about loans, investment accounts, budget planning and borrowing limits, NAB said in a statement.
They could also explore "what-if" scenarios for savings and borrowings, and get help in opening accounts.
NAB chief general manager Frank Cicutto said obtaining information from the terminals was easier and more convenient than reading a brochure or making an appointment to see a banker.
Twelve terminals had been installed at seven branches around Melbourne.
